topic: Ohara's scholars saved their research by putting their books into a lake, a side point of the Void Century silence story
title: Ohara's Scholars Hid Their Books In A Lake
description: Ohara's scholars lost their island but their books survived in a lake, Vegapunk, Dragon and the Elbaph giants found them. One Piece Egghead arc detail explained.
comment: Did Ohara lose, or did its scholars win the only way they could?

lines.text: Ohara's scholars lost their island and still won, and almost nobody notices how.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: A few months after the Buster Call, Vegapunk visited what was left of Ohara.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: He found a lake packed to the brim with books.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Those were the scholars' final acts, and Shaka tells it as Ohara's victory.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Then it gets better. Giants from Elbaph were dredging that lake, led by a giant covered in bandages.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: So the books never went to the Government. They went to a scientist, a rebel and the giants.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Vegapunk read every one of them, and told his employers nothing. That is chapter 1066's quiet bombshell.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: People say Ohara lost, because the island is gone. But the island was never the point.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: So if the books were safe, why did the world still forget a whole century?

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: And that lake is exactly why

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light
